hero-lede2:
AI is a tool for people. People must not become tools for AI.

Most of what makes you better at things is not AI at all. Search. Spreadsheets. Notes. Reminders. A little automation. These everyday tools already do most of the work. What is new is that AI can go and use them for you, and then explain them back to you in words you already know.

Put all of that together and something changes. The thing slowing you down is no longer the tool. It is what you can picture yourself doing with it.

AI is a tool for humans — humans must not be tools for AI.

Most of what makes you more capable isn't AI at all. Search, spreadsheets, notes, reminders, a little automation — everyday tools already do most of the work. What's new is that AI can reach them for you, and explain them back in words you already use.

Put those together and the thing holding you back changes. It stops being the tool, and starts being what you can imagine doing with it.
